stages.name: Faded Ember Court
stages.narrative: Gatherglow has found a place where people might meet, but its old ember is cold and the court feels forgotten.
stages.floor: Mostly bare faded terracotta earth with two broad worn cream patches and no central ring.
stages.landmark: One tiny unlit ember alcove beneath a simple rear-center timber arch.
props: one plain backless seat at upper-left
one empty tea crate at upper-right
stages.lighting: Soft neutral dusk with no active lantern or hearth glow.
stages.density: Very sparse, quiet, and visibly incomplete.

stages.name: First Welcome
stages.narrative: One warm lantern and somewhere to sit make a first low-pressure welcome possible.
stages.floor: Warm terracotta remains dominant with a few broad cream hearth slabs near the rear.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center alcove is repaired and holds one softly glowing ember.
props: one curved conversation bench at upper-left
one simple tea trolley at upper-right
stages.lighting: Gentle dusk with one ember and two restrained lantern pools.
stages.density: A modest first gathering place built from large useful forms.

stages.name: Shared Hearth
stages.narrative: Gatherglow creates a dependable place for honest conversation and comfortable company.
stages.floor: A few oversized softly beveled terracotta slabs establish the hearth floor while the lower standing patch remains open.
stages.landmark: The rear-center alcove becomes a broad open timber hearth pavilion with a gently arched amber roof.
props: one shared supper table with four chunky stools
the upper-left curved bench and lantern
the upper-right tea trolley and two rounded ember planters
stages.lighting: Soft warm dusk from one broad hearth and three large lantern pools.
stages.density: Clearly established and welcoming without social or table clutter.

stages.name: Gathering Garden
stages.narrative: The hearth opens into a generous garden where familiar faces and new connections both have room.
stages.floor: Rich terracotta and cream floor masses create a warm composition around the small lower standing patch.
stages.landmark: The same pavilion grows into a rounded open gathering lodge with a taller amber canopy and glowing linked-loop emblem.
props: a longer shared table and six broad stools
stages.lighting: Warm sunset dusk with layered but restrained pavilion and lantern glow.
stages.density: Rich and communal through bold seating and architecture, not tiny decoration.

stages.name: Beacon of Belonging
stages.narrative: Gatherglow's home becomes the Haven's definitive landmark for friendship, welcome, and being known.
stages.floor: Polished low-detail terracotta hearth paving surrounds the small lower standing patch in broad readable masses.
stages.landmark: The same rear-center lodge culminates in a signature tall glowing pavilion with layered amber roof, broad hearth arch, and one oversized linked-loop emblem without text.
props: a resolved curved communal supper table
the upper-right tea and welcome station
stages.lighting: Luminous celebratory dusk with a broad welcoming beacon glow.
stages.density: Definitive signature destination with a strong warm skyline and no micro-detail.
